title: 彭博气象员：创纪录热浪或将被打破
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The record highs for this time of the year, Tom, are in the range that we're going to see temperatures climb up to.
segments.zh: 汤姆，今年此时的最高气温纪录，我们即将看到气温攀升至那个范围。

segments.en: The all time records in southern New England are the 4th of July, 1911, when we had temperatures around 106 degrees in Boston and
segments.zh: 新英格兰南部的历史最高纪录是1911年7月4日，当时波士顿气温约106华氏度。

segments.en: Nashville, New Hampshire, for the New York City area, the records this time of year, generally around 100 to 102.
segments.zh: 纳什维尔和新罕布什尔州，纽约市地区此时纪录通常在100到102华氏度。
这些纪录是在1901年和1966年创下的。

segments.en: Same thing for Washington, the records in Washington, around 100 to 600 and set.
segments.zh: 华盛顿也是如此，纪录在100到600华氏度之间并已设定。

segments.en: So this heat this time of year is precedented.
segments.zh: 所以今年此时的高温是有先例的。

segments.en: I can actually share and show you the latest satellite photo.
segments.zh: 我可以分享并展示最新的卫星照片。

segments.en: And what it shows is what we meteorologists refer to as the ring of fire.
segments.zh: 它显示了我们气象学家所说的火环。

segments.en: We got a big high over Kentucky in Tennessee, and they get showers and thunderstorms climbing around the outside of that.
segments.zh: 肯塔基和田纳西上空有一个大高压，周围有阵雨和雷暴。

segments.en: One of those storms moving across South Dakota on Monday produced winds of 130 miles an hour.
segments.zh: 周一南达科他州的一场风暴产生了时速130英里的风。

segments.en: Wow. The issue is as these storms go up through the Western Great Lakes, the leftovers, the convective debris will be drifting through the Northeast.
segments.zh: 问题是，当这些风暴经过五大湖西部时，残留的对流碎片会飘向东北部。

segments.en: And I think that may limit how hot it gets in New York and Boston, probably gets up to 99 or 100, right, keeps us away from the records.
segments.zh: 我认为这可能会限制纽约和波士顿的高温，大概升到99或100华氏度，不会破纪录。

segments.en: Right. I think record highs are better bet in the mid-Atlantic states because they're not going to have that convective debris.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为中大西洋地区更可能创下高温纪录，因为它们没有对流碎片。

segments.en: I mean, your courage on this Rob is noted. We all know that is this just media hype that we're, you know, borderline hysterical on this.
segments.zh: 罗布，你的勇气值得注意。我们都知道这不过是媒体炒作，我们对此近乎歇斯底里。
